answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by coupling quadratic stake bonds with localized peer latency probes. Each agent locks tokens in escrow and answers round-trip probes within strict bounds. When an identity acts, an attestation ripple propagates across its neighbors; equivocating signatures slash the entire bond. An honest participant maintains one presence across a meadow of peers, while an attacker faces an economic tundra: running k fake identities demands k distinct bonds and separate physical routing, forcing attacker expenditure to scale superlinearly.
